name: Software request
description: Spec, freeze tests, build, apply docs, close.

stages.title: Spec
stages.instructions: Propose the acceptance criteria with clara_criteria. Every criterion needs a test_path or human_gate=true. Do not read source code; use the request record and the docs it points at. Then call clara_stage_done with {"criteria_count": <n>, "docs_impact": "<impact or none>"}. A human must approve.

stages.title: Test
stages.instructions: Write the tests that define done for the approved criteria. Use clara_ask to read them. Freeze the suite with clara_freeze, then call clara_stage_done with {"tests_hash": "<hash>", "tests_total": <n>}. Do not edit source.

stages.title: Build
stages.instructions: Implement the request against the frozen tests. Use clara_checkpoint at each boundary. Do not edit tests. When complete, call clara_stage_done with {"summary": "<what changed>", "criteria_addressed": [<positions>]}. If a kill criterion fires, write a checkpoint with blocked_on and stop.

stages.title: Docs
stages.instructions: Apply the request's docs_impact to the workspace docs. Never edit docs/features or docs/index.md. If the impact no longer applies cleanly, reconcile against current truth and record it. When done, call clara_stage_done for this stage. If you cannot reconcile, open a decision with clara_decide and stop.

stages.title: Judge
stages.instructions: Close only from ledger evidence: call clara_ask once and check the criteria, stage evidence, and human gates. Do not read source or run commands; there is no shell and the close gate does not re-hash. If every gate is recorded, call clara_stage_done with {"result": "<final result>", "artifacts": [<paths, URLs, or text>]}. Otherwise open one decision with clara_decide and stop. Do not write code.
